questions.q: The perimeter of a rhombus is 120 cm. One of the diagonal is 36 cm. What is the length (in cm) of the other diagonal?
questions.solution:
Side = 120/4 = 30 cm. Half the given diagonal is 18, so the other half-diagonal = √(30² − 18²) = √576 = 24, making the other diagonal 48 cm.

**Answer: 48**

questions.q: The distance between the parallel sides of a trapezium is 30 cm. The length of the line joining the mid-points of the non-parallel sides is 12 cm. What is the area (in square cm) of the trapezium?
questions.solution:
The line joining the mid-points of the non-parallel sides equals half the sum of the parallel sides: (a + b)/2 = 12 cm.
Area = (a + b)/2 × height = 12 × 30 = 360 sq cm.

**Answer: 360**

questions.q: What is the Highest Common Factor of 0.48, 0.64 and 0.80?
questions.solution:
Ignoring the common two decimal places, HCF(48, 64, 80) = 16, so the HCF of 0.48, 0.64 and 0.80 is 0.16.

**Answer: 0.16**
questions.shortcut: HCF of 48, 64, 80 = 16 → shift the decimal two places.

A rectangular courtyard, 4.56 meters long and 7.68 meters wide is paved exactly with square tiles of same size. Find the size (in cm) of the largest tile that can be used for this purpose.
questions.solution:
Convert to centimetres: 456 cm × 768 cm. The largest square tile that paves it exactly has side = HCF(456, 768).
456 = 2³ × 3 × 19 and 768 = 2⁸ × 3, so HCF = 2³ × 3 = 24 cm.

**Answer: 24**
questions.shortcut: Tile size = HCF of the sides in cm: HCF(456, 768) = 24.

questions.q: A is 5 times more than B. A is what percent more than B?
questions.solution:
'5 times more than B' means A = B + 5B = 6B, so A exceeds B by 5B.
Percentage more = (5B/B) × 100 = 500%.

**Answer: 500 percent**

questions.q: The cost price of 120 articles is same as the selling price of y articles. If there is a loss of 4 percent, then what is the value of y? (Cost price of all the articles is same. Selling price of all the articles is same)
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of one article be Re. 1. CP of 120 articles = 120, and with a 4% loss the SP of y articles is 0.96y.
0.96y = 120 → y = 125.

**Answer: 125**

questions.q: R alone can complete a work in 40 days. S alone can complete the same work in 50 days. They work together for 10 days. What part of total work is completed?
questions.solution:
In 10 days R completes 10/40 = 1/4 of the work and S completes 10/50 = 1/5.
Together: 1/4 + 1/5 = 9/20.

**Answer: 9/20**

questions.q: M and R together can do a work in 8 days. R and P together can do the same work in 6 days. P and M together can do the same work in 12 days. In how many days can P alone do the same work?
questions.solution:
Adding the three pair rates: 2(1/M + 1/R + 1/P) = 1/8 + 1/6 + 1/12 = 3/8, so 1/M + 1/R + 1/P = 3/16.
Since 1/M + 1/R = 1/8, we get 1/P = 3/16 − 1/8 = 1/16.
P alone needs 16 days.

**Answer: 16**
questions.shortcut: Sum of pair rates ÷ 2 = all-three rate; subtract M+R's 1/8 → 1/P = 1/16.

questions.q: The length of a train is 210 metres. Speed of the train is 25 m/s. How much time (in seconds) will it take to cross a bridge of length 590 metres?
questions.solution:
Distance to cover = train length + bridge length = 210 + 590 = 800 m.
Time = 800/25 = 32 s.

**Answer: 32**

questions.q: An article is sold for 30 percent profit. The value of discount given is equal to the (2/5) of the selling price. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
SP = 1.3 CP. The discount equals (2/5) of SP, so MP = SP + (2/5)SP = (7/5)SP.
CP = SP/1.3 = (10/13)SP = (10/13) × (5/7)MP = (50/91) of the marked price.

**Answer: (50/91) of marked price**
questions.shortcut: MP = 7/5 SP and CP = 10/13 SP → CP = 50/91 MP.

questions.q: Which of the following will have selling price Rs. 3500?
options: Marked price = Rs. 4000 and Discount = 15 percent
Marked price = Rs. 4500 and Discount = 10 percent
Marked price = Rs. 5500 and Discount = 40 percent
Marked price = Rs. 5000 and Discount = 30 percent
questions.solution:
Selling prices: 4000 × 0.85 = 3400; 4500 × 0.90 = 4050; 5500 × 0.60 = 3300; 5000 × 0.70 = 3500.
Only option 4 gives exactly Rs. 3500.

**Answer: Marked price = Rs. 5000 and Discount = 30 percent**
